title: 第一卷 第17章 碾压四人，秘境立威
novel_title: 凡人修仙：疯了吧，你百岁高龄才入门
content_zh:
一掌震退炼气五层的黑衣弟子。

    骨头轻响，灵力崩散。

    那黑衣弟子整个人砸落在草丛之中，手臂扭曲浮肿，痛得浑身抽搐，根本爬不起来。

    这一幕，彻底吓懵剩余三人。

    三名外门弟子瞳孔骤缩，背脊瞬间发凉。

    不可能！

    绝对不可能！

    区区炼气二层，还是个肉身腐朽的百岁老者！

    怎么可能一掌击溃炼气五层的同门？

    而且赢得如此干净利落，完全是碾压！

    “一起上！不要怕他！”

    短暂惊骇过后，一名高个弟子咬牙嘶吼。

    三人迅速结成简易合围阵势。

    三道灵力光束齐齐迸发，封锁苏玄尘所有闪避方位。

    炼气四层、四层、三层！

    三道灵力交织，气息不弱。

    在他们看来，刚才只是师兄大意失手。

    三人联手，绝对能稳稳镇压对方！

    劲风呼啸，灵力扑面。

    苏玄尘面色依旧淡然，不见半分慌乱。

    他的灵力，是极品天灵根凝练而出。

    同阶无敌，越阶轻松！

    再加上《青元养身诀》洗脉固本，他的肉身强度，早已远超表面的老朽模样。

    “无谓挣扎。”

    苏玄尘低声轻吐四字。

    脚步轻踏，身形飘忽。

    看似缓慢，却精准避开所有灵力轰击。
content_en:
With one palm, the black-clothed disciple at the fifth level of Qi refining was knocked back.

    The bones crackled softly, and the spiritual power collapsed.

    The black-clothed disciple fell completely into the grass, his arms were twisted and swollen, his whole body was twitching in pain, and he couldn't get up at all.

    This scene completely frightened the remaining three people.

    The pupils of the three outer disciples shrank suddenly, and their spines instantly felt cold.

    impossible!

    Absolutely impossible!

    He's only on the second level of Qi Refining, but he's still a hundred-year-old man with a decaying body!

    How could it be possible to defeat a fellow disciple at the fifth level of Qi Refining with one palm?

    And winning so cleanly, it was a complete crush!

    "Come together! Don't be afraid of him!"

    After a brief moment of shock, a tall disciple gritted his teeth and roared.

    The three quickly formed a simple encirclement formation.

    Three spiritual beams burst out together, blocking all Su Xuanchen's dodge directions.

    Fourth level, fourth level, third level of Qi refining!

    The three spiritual powers are intertwined, and the breath is not weak.

    In their opinion, it was just a careless mistake by the senior brother.

    The three of them working together can definitely suppress each other!

    The strong wind howled, and the spiritual power hit my face.

    Su Xuanchen's expression remained calm, without any hint of panic.

    His spiritual power is condensed from the highest quality heavenly spiritual roots.

    Invincible at the same level, easy to cross levels!

    Coupled with the "Qingyuan Body Nurturing Technique" to cleanse and strengthen the veins, his physical strength has already far exceeded his superficial appearance.

    "It's a useless struggle."

    Su Xuanchen whispered four words in a low voice.

    The steps are light and the body is erratic.

    It seems slow, but it accurately avoids all spiritual bombardments.
title_en: Volume 1 Chapter 17 Crush four people and establish authority in the secret realm
